description: ContextStore uses a single RLock (threading.RLock) at the store instance level, not per-conversation locks.

test_scenario.method: Concurrent POST requests to /v1/chat/completions with same X-Local2API-Conversation-ID
test_scenario.expected: serialized execution, no duplicate turns, no lost updates, no reordered canonical state, no corrupt JSON, no conflicting turn IDs
test_scenario.note: Uses single store-instance RLock, not per-conversation lock map. All conversations serialized through same lock.

conclusion: Implementation uses single global RLock per ContextStore instance, not per-conversation locks. This serializes all conversations through the same lock, not just same-conversation requests.
